_note: By sample data version (lib/samplePortfolio.js SAMPLE_DATA_VERSION): figures the Model Fund I sample documents state that changed in that version, as [asset, field, old value, new value]. The automatic load (lib/sampleDocTerms.js withSampleTermChanges) writes the new value only where the asset still holds the old one, so anything the user changed is kept. A field under "sale." is on the asset's sample sale. Version 8 (1.1.21): the sample leases' rent steps moved year-one NOI by a few hundred dollars, and two broker opinions (rounded to the nearest $50,000) with it. Version 12 (1.1.27): the construction management fee moved to construction spending, so the IC memo states a higher return.
